ops.title: Ship Graphite stacked-diff support: cc-interact v0.23.0 + cc-review bump
ops.description: Cross-repo release coupling for stacked-diff review (plan: ~/.claude/plans/lets-support-stacked-diffs-encapsulated-valley.md). cc-interact gains vcs.DetectStack/CaptureStack (vcs/graphite.go); cc-review hard-cuts to a version_sections store model consuming it. Dev builds bridge via `go mod edit -replace github.com/yasyf/cc-interact=/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-interact` — the replace MUST be dropped before shipping cc-review.

ops.text: cc-interact: vcs/graphite.go + tests landed, go test ./... green, CHANGELOG entry, tagged v0.23.0
cc-review: go.mod requires cc-interact v0.23.0 with no replace directive
cc-review: go test -race ./... green and web build embedded before go build
Manual E2E on a real gt 1.8.6 stack passes the plan's 6-step checklist
